card.name: Flight and atmosphere layer descriptions
card.fires_on: Words and small linking words or number spaces inside text about flight, spacecraft trajectories or atmosphere layers (troposphere, stratosphere). It is strongest on the word flying in a simulation sentence.

modes.label: Flying verb
modes.description: The word flying after a verb like simulate, in aerospace text.
modes.example: These were used to simulate<< flying>> a shuttle like vehicle.

modes.label: Linking words in spacecraft route
modes.description: Small words such as to, its, the inside a sentence about launching a spacecraft on a trajectory.
modes.example: boosted it with a Centaur upper stage in order<< to>> bring it into its complicated trajectory through the

modes.label: Atmosphere altitude lists
modes.description: The space or digit after a dash or to in a list of atmosphere layer heights.

card.writes: It seems to push against flight words like flying and airborne, and slightly toward navigation or drive terms.
card.plain: It lights up in aviation, space and atmosphere text, on small words where a flight word might come next.
